div.head: Duns 1.1
div.ab: Fo se syððan to ðe þæt land age ⁊ hæbbe him ða æscan; ⁊ ðæs on IX nihton gylde þæt yrfe oððe to ðam dæge underwed lecge, þæt sy ðæs orfes oðer healf weorð, ⁊ ðæs on IX nihton þæt wed undo mid rihtan gylde.

Et recipiat ille in cuius terra deducetur et habeat ipsam inquisitionem; et inde ad nouem dies reddat ipsam pecuniam uel uadium ponat ipsa die, quod ualeat quesitam et inuestigatam pecuniam sesqualteram, et inde ad nouem dies ipsum uadium redimat recta persolutione.

Alsdann übernehme [die Spurfolge] wer das [dortige] Land [sammt Immunität] besitzt und erhalte für sich die [weitere] Untersuchung [sammt Ertrag aus Bestrafung des Diebes]; doch bezahle er das Vieh in 9 Tagen von dem [Übernehmen] ab oder hinterlege an diesem Termin ein Unterpfand, das anderthalb des Viehes werth ist, und löse von da in 9 Tagen dies Unterpfand ein durch richtige Bezahlung [des Viehes].

Then let him who owns the land [there, with its jurisdiction] take over [the pursuit of the track] and keep for himself the [further] inquiry [together with the profit from punishing the thief]; but let him pay for the cattle within 9 days from [taking it over], or on that day deposit a pledge worth one and a half times the cattle, and from then within 9 days redeem that pledge by proper payment [for the cattle].

Then whoever owns that [local] territory has it [the investigation] to demand [ie. takes it over], and within nine days restores the cattle or on the same day deposits a pledge worth one and a half time the value of the cattle, and this pledge on the ninth day redeem [ie the balance] through proper payment [for the cattle to the owner].
div.note: U: translator unrecorded: check; Liebermann compares VI As 8.4 and 2.

note.seg: Bessere Übs. Z. 1: ‘Alsdann greife ein wer’. Es ist dieselbe Redensart wie VI As 8, 4.—Land agan heisst ‘neben dem Boden auch die daran hängenden politischen Rechte besitzen’. Dieser Gutseigner vertritt die polizeiliche Funktion des Sheriffs bzw. Hundredmanns in VI As 8, 4 bzw. Hu 5

Better transl. l. 1: ‘Then let him intervene who’. It is the same phrase as VI As 8, 4.—Land agan means ‘to possess not only the soil but also the political rights attached to it’. This landowner takes the place, in his police function, of the sheriff in VI As 8, 4 and of the hundredman in Hu 5
Nicht bloss Verantwortlichkeit (Earle), sondern auch Justizertrag
Not merely responsibility (Earle), but also the profits of justice
Diese Frist begegnet noch zweimal 1, 1. 2; s. o. Einl. 11
This period occurs twice more, 1, 1. 2; see above Introduction 11
